cases.title: The broker refuses a request that names a URL or host
cases.when: The sandbox posts /v1/call with a url or host member instead of a route id
then: 400 ROUTE_REFUSED; nothing is sent upstream; the refusal is audited

cases.title: A route outside the permit route set is refused
cases.when: The sandbox calls a route id that exists in the service profile but not in the permit's routes
then: ROUTE_REFUSED; audited with the route id

cases.title: The broker enforces the profile named by the permit digest only
cases.when: The admin approves a newer service profile revision while an invocation admitted on the older digest is running
then: The running invocation keeps using the older profile
A profile digest absent from the content store refuses every request

cases.title: Path variables cannot escape their template
cases.when: pathVars contain "/", "..", "%2e%2e", "%2F", overlong UTF-8 and values that violate the variable pattern
then: Every variant is refused before connect
Valid values are percent-encoded exactly once

cases.title: Disallowed query names, headers, methods, content types and sizes are refused
cases.when: The sandbox sends an unknown query name, a header not in allowedHeaders, a CRLF in a header value, a body above maxRequestBytes, and a content type not in requestContentTypes
then: Each request is refused with ROUTE_REFUSED
No request reaches the upstream

cases.title: Client-supplied auth headers are stripped and refused, never merged
cases.when: The sandbox sends Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie, Host, X-Forwarded-For and the route's auth header name
then: The request is refused
A request without them reaches the upstream with Host from the destination and the injected credential only

cases.title: Responses are filtered before they reach the sandbox
cases.when: The upstream returns Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate with realm details, and a body above maxResponseBytes
then: Set-Cookie and auth challenge details are removed
The response is cut at maxResponseBytes with an error

cases.title: A capability from another sandbox or invocation is refused
cases.when: Sandbox A presents sandbox B's capability on A's socket, and a capability after its invocation was cancelled
then: Both are refused; attribution is by accepting socket

cases.title: The broker never retries or redirects for a ledger tool
cases.when: An upstream for a NON_IDEMPOTENT tool returns 503, then a 307 within the same destination
then: Exactly one upstream request is sent
The redirect is not followed
The tool receives the 503 and the effect evidence is recorded

cases.title: Per-invocation and per-route rate, byte and connection caps hold
cases.when: A tool exceeds the route request rate, total egress bytes and concurrent connections
then: Requests over each cap are refused with CONCURRENCY_LIMIT or ROUTE_REFUSED and audited

cases.title: Streaming is refused unless the route allows it
cases.when: A NONE-streaming route receives a chunked upload and a server-sent-events response
then: The request is refused; the response is buffered to maxResponseBytes or refused

cases.title: Every broker decision is audited without bodies or credentials
cases.when: Accepted and refused requests are made
then: Each audit record has invocationId, route id, destination id, method, status, bytes, duration, upstream request id or refusal reason
No record contains a body or credential
